warning_text: GOVERNMENT WARNING: (1) According to the Surgeon General, women should not drink alcoholic beverages during pregnancy because of the risk of birth defects. (2) Consumption of alcoholic beverages impairs your ability to drive a car or operate machinery, and may cause health problems.
notes: Brand and alcohol read from front.jpg; net contents, alcohol and the warning read from back.jpg.
Both images print the alcohol statement identically: 'ALC. 12.8% BY VOL.'
Warning body is in sentence case; only the heading 'GOVERNMENT WARNING:' is in capitals, and it is set in the same regular weight as the body, not bold.
